name: ui-clocks
responsibility: The clocks the browser UI reads: the frame clock that motion steps on, stepped frame by frame for a replay or a test, and time as text
description: Layer 0, area ui, @archboard/ui-clocks (TASK-653.17): ui-kit's frame clock and time as text, moved out whole, because tests and recordings drive frames and draw nothing with ui-kit. Two entries and no root, width 16. ./frame-clock (13): frameClock, driveFramesFrom, createSteppedClock(start, takeFramesOf?), and class SteppedClock with now, requestFrame, cancelFrame, after, cancelAfter, advanceTo, runFrame, syncAnimations and paint. ./time (3): useClock, shortAge, clockDuration. The web app, agent-surfaces and the system motion fixture call it; it calls nothing of ours. The built page keeps it in the controls chunk.
